title: Setting up Environmental Management Center (EMC) in Serbia

body: I edited International Science Conference “Reporting for Sustainability” proceedings. Besides that publication, the main EMC project outputs are the established Environmental Management Center within Serbian Agency for Environmental Protection (SEPA) including necessary computer hardware and software, training of personnel, introducing efficient and sound routines and practices. EMC project worked directly with governmental institutions and 10 selected large industrial client-partners from various industrial sectors across Serbia: petrochemical industry, agricultural sector, railways, rubber manufacturing, coal production and processing, steel production and processing, copper mining and smelting, as well as public utility providing district heating.
